title: Project Scaffolder - public implementations survey
definition: Generates starter directories, files, and configurations.
description:
This database surveys Project Scaffolder as it exists in public practice: Generates starter directories, files, and configurations. The records below name real tools with real track records, explain the techniques they are built on, cite the standards they implement, and provide drills that build working skill. Nothing here is speculative - every implementation is a real project you can download, every technique is established practice.

The value of a survey like this is comparative: seeing seven real implementations side by side reveals what the capability truly requires and where each tool draws its boundaries. The technique records go deeper, explaining the machinery - the algorithms, protocols and disciplines - that make Project Scaffolder work regardless of which tool you pick.

Use this database as a field guide. When a build calls for Project Scaffolder, consult the spotlights to choose an implementation, check the standards to stay interoperable, and run the drills to build fluency. Each record's demo program runs with node - the capability is demonstrated end to end.

title: GCC - related Project Scaffolder technology
definition: The GNU compiler suite for C, C++ and Fortran.
description:
Every Project Scaffolder practitioner meets GCC sooner or later. The GNU compiler suite for C, C++ and Fortran.

It supports Project Scaffolder work from the side: It composes well because it was built to be composed - clean boundaries, documented formats, and no hidden global state. That supporting role is why it earned a place here among the related technologies rather than the direct implementations.

Treat GCC as a solid foundation to build on in the Project Scaffolder toolkit. Run the attached demo to see its central mechanism execute on concrete data.
